title: Cross-site scripting (XSS) in Selenium Grid hub's web interface due to unvalidated user input from node configuration
cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
trigger_payload: A node can register to a hub using the following configuration file, where an XSS payload is given in the hub parameter.
oracle: Injected JavaScript code is executed on the user's browser and can be seen by inspecting the page source.
